    Product Description

    1979-2004 Mustang Extended Length Steel Braided Front Brake Lines by Drift American

    Improve your pedal feel, and piece of mind with our extended length steel braided brake lines designed to work with massive angle! 

    • 18" Length is long enough to work on all angle kits
    • Designed to work with Cobra calipers, and GT/V6 calipers
    • Specific Foxbody and SN95 lines
    • Steel braided to improve pedal feel, and increased durability
    • Comes with crush washers
    • Available in Red, Blue, Black, Clear or Smoked
    • Pressure tested to ensure quality/safety
    • DOT Approved
    • Sold as a pair
    • Made in the USA

    Please note:  These brake lines are sold as a front pair only, and are made to order. Lead time is typically 2-5 days. If you need lines ASAP, select "Doesn't matter to me!" as the color and we will ship what we have in stock. 

    Brake Line Body Fittings vary by year. We've seen them be all over the place (Thanks, Ford!) but typically most later model year Foxbody Mustangs use a 7/16 body fitting on both sides, while 94-04 SN95 Mustangs use a 3/8 on one side, and a 7/16 on the other. Once again, please verify and let us know if possible what size body fittings that you may have.
